question: Can two independent TORC compact critiques share one Codex harness invocation without losing deterministic defect recall?
capability_success_requires: both candidate critiques are schema-valid and correctly attributed
both critiques request changes with full deterministic defect recall
provider-reported batch input is at least 20 percent below the summed matched direct medians
batch completion time is no greater than the summed matched direct medians
no tool, subagent, MCP, app, browser, or web action occurs

decision.on_success: freeze a repeated counterbalanced batching series before recommending batch size or general savings
decision.on_quality_failure: preserve and stop; fixed-context savings do not justify cross-candidate interference
decision.on_cost_failure: preserve and stop; batching does not materially amortize this harness
decision.on_execution_failure: preserve and exclude the only attempt without automatic retry
